svg.title: Nominal patch placement at 0.75× speed
svg.desc: Four 40-sample waveform patches start every 15 source samples and are copied unchanged into output positions 20 samples apart. Each row is one patch, and rows overlap in time when combined.
svg.text: Copy the same patches farther apart in output time
Each row is one patch. Copying preserves its width and waveform.
Stack the output rows in time and blend their overlaps. Alignment corrections come next.
